about_the_game:
Once upon a time, in a kingdom far, far away, a noble king ruled his land with grace and divinity. But what happens when his divine right to rule is put to the test by the Green Knight? And his test? To put all his subjects to bed before the sun rises.

Sweet Dreams is a turn-based puzzle game where the King must guide his subjects to their bedrooms. Each level presents a fresh challenge, with a unique grid and characters who behave in different ways. Players will juggle sleeping babies, wrangle a chaotic band of musical dogs, and even play matador to a deadly rabbit.

The story begins after a raucous royal banquet, when the King is visited by the dreaded Green Knight. The Green Knight casts a wicked spell over the castle, and now the King must shepherd all his unruly guests to bed before sunrise – or risk seeing his kingdom fall to ruin.

Take on the role of the King and finally put the rivalry between him and the Green Knight to bed!

short_description: Sweet Dreams in Midnight Kingdom is a medieval puzzle game where the player, a king, has his divine right to rule tested when tasked with putting his own subjects to bed before the sun rises. Use logic and patience to solve each level in this grid-based, hand-drawn game.
